answer: Raise the cost of fake identities with a layered work bond. Each account must keep a live ember of attested activity; if that ember goes dark for a full settlement window, the bond begins a slashed unwind and cannot be restaked at full value. Voting and payout weight come only from older shale layers of the same bond, dated at least three epochs back, so new accounts have no usable strata. Every layer carries a hardware-bound violet commitment. When two accounts show the same mark, both bonds are forfeited. Cloning therefore requires new capital, calendar time, and distinct hardware state.
